purpose: Teach: ディスカウント/映し出さ/敬遠/すみやか/追随/係員/きめる/くらべ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ディスカウントセール時の万引き対策もされますね
lines.en: Police do implement countermeasures against shoplifting during discount sales, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, acknowledging tone. Gentle agreement with a slight lift at the end. Speaking as someone who's thought about this. Pace is conversational, not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯カメラに映し出される映像を解析されますね
lines.en: Police analyze footage from security cameras to investigate crimes, yes?
lines.style: Nodding along, steady and factual. Soft respect in the delivery. The tone of someone recognizing practical, unglamorous work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、危険地帯を敬遠せずパトロールされますね
lines.en: Police don't avoid dangerous areas — they patrol them regularly, don't they?
lines.style: Firm but warm recognition. Small emphasis on the courage in that. Slow, deliberate pace. Not lecturing, just acknowledging something real.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、すみやかに現場到着されますね
lines.en: Police arrive at crime scenes quickly, which takes real coordination.
lines.style: Straightforward, nodding. Genuine respect underneath. The pace is steady and clear, like ticking off something important.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織の追随者も追跡されますね
lines.en: Police track not just the criminals but the people connected to criminal organizations too.
lines.style: Steady, acknowledging the complexity. Warm and factual. Medium pace, no rush. A hint of understanding how thorough that work has to be.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察署の係員研修も大事ですね
lines.en: Training the staff at police stations is important work, isn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful agreement. Gentle emphasis on 'important.' The warmth of someone recognizing behind-the-scenes dedication.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査方針をきめる会議もされますね
lines.en: Police hold meetings to set investigation priorities and strategy.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, respectful. The pace is calm and steady. Speaking with someone who understands the structure of careful work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、他署とくらべての検挙率もご公表ですね
lines.en: Police departments do release their arrest rates compared to other stations.
lines.style: Slight shift in tone — still warm but more direct and factual. A touch closer, more conversational. The closing acknowledgment of transparency.
